rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: The Rent Board's allowable rent increase is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_text: Units subject to the San Francisco Rent Board's allowable annual increase.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: The security deposit interest rate is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Relocation Payments (Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C)
rules.requirement: For evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work or substantial rehabilitation, with eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the relocation amount due is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to a maximum of $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; maximum $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Ellis Act Relocation Payments (37.9A)
rules.requirement: For tenants evicted under the Ellis Act with eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the relocation amount due is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to a maximum of $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; maximum $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement for Less Than 20 Days
rules.requirement: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9; for eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 the amount due per tenant household is $446.00/day (plus actual moving expenses).
rules.key_value: $446.00/day (plus actual moving expenses) per tenant household
rules.coverage_text: Tenant households temporarily displaced for less than 20 days for capital improvement work.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction_text: governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C
